text:
We're hiring a Backend Engineer (remote, EU time zones).

The team is growing, and we need another backend engineer to help build the systems our customers rely on every day. They have to be fast and they have to be reliable.

Our services are written in Go, and Postgres is our main datastore. We're a small team that works closely together. We care about clean code and careful reviews, and we ship often.

The salary range is €70,000–€95,000, depending on experience. The role is fully remote, but you'll need to be in an EU time zone. You'll also own your work: what you build goes to production, and it matters.

We try not to waste your time, so there are only three interview rounds. The first is an intro call where we get to know each other and talk about the role. The second is a technical conversation about how you design and build backend systems. The last is a meeting with the team so you can see how we work together.

You'd probably fit in well if you've built and run production services, you like hard data problems, and you enjoy working with people who take their craft seriously.

If you're interested, apply through the link or DM me. And if you know someone who'd be a good fit, sharing this with them helps a lot.
